prompt: Summarize the excerpt from 'dmoi3-tablet' (chunk 71.4) about mathematics: The sets will contain all the different ways the event can happen. (It will be helpful to be able to switch back and for
true_answer: The sets will contain all the different ways the event can happen. (It will be helpful to be able to switch back and forth between these two models when checking that we have counted correctly.) Here’s what we mean: Example 1.1.6 Suppose you own 9 shirts and 5 pairs of pants. 1. How many outfits can you make? 2. If today is half-naked-day, and you will wear only a shirt or only a pair of pants, how many choices do you have? Solution . By now you should agree that the answer to the first question is 9 · 5 | 45 and the answer to the second question is 9 + 5 | 14 .
